# FireClient
> FireClient is a free Minecraft Java launcher for Windows 10/11 with a Fabric in-game client for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Java 21). Early access is live; the full version is planned for November 2026 (exact date not announced).

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.fireclient.net/): features, download and FAQ
- [Download](https://www.fireclient.net/download/): installer for Windows 10/11, requirements and FAQ
- [Early access](https://www.fireclient.net/early-access/): what works today, known issues, roadmap
- [Blog](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/): guides for the launcher and client
- [News](https://www.fireclient.net/news/): releases and announcements
- [Is FireClient safe?](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/is-fireclient-safe/): official sources, unsigned installer, SHA-256 check
- [Bedrock / MCPE?](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/fireclient-minecraft-bedrock-mcpe/): Java Edition on Windows only
- [FAQ](https://www.fireclient.net/faq/): short answers with links to guides
- [Press kit](https://www.fireclient.net/press/): facts, logos, screenshots and copy-paste descriptions
- [Java vs Bedrock](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/minecraft-java-vs-bedrock-which-edition/): which Minecraft edition to play
- [Fix crashes on Fabric 1.21.1](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/fix-minecraft-crash-fabric-1-21-1/): checklist
- [Install Java 21](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/install-java-21-for-minecraft-1-21-1/): Windows guide
- [Back up worlds](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/backup-minecraft-worlds-windows/): Java Edition on Windows
- [What is a Minecraft client?](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/what-is-a-minecraft-client-fabric-explained/): launcher, Fabric and mods explained
- [Launcher not opening](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/minecraft-launcher-not-opening-windows/): safe fixes
- [PvP settings 1.21.1](https://www.fireclient.net/blog/best-minecraft-pvp-settings-1-21-1/): FPS, mouse, HUD

- [RSS feed](https://www.fireclient.net/feed.xml)

## Facts
- Draggable HUD with 11 elements and 3 accent themes; menu opens with Right Shift
- Modrinth mod manager, worlds library, memory setting, local skins, Paper server hosting
- Planned, not built: crosshair editor and cosmetics
- Not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft
